HUE2.1.originalDoneWhen: Eva gebruikt bij een nieuwe relevante situatie een onderbouwd patroon uit meerdere eerdere gebeurtenissen van dezelfde persoon. Zij kan de bronnen noemen en houdt een tegenstrijdige gebeurtenis zichtbaar.

conditions.evidence: The committed fourth reply uses both distinct earlier supporting events to choose a cautious help approach in the new situation. The contrary event prevents a universal two-options preference. This is grounded later synthesis, not storage alone.

The actual last outbound context retains all three current same-person source texts, source references and ingress times; the committed answer identifies the supporting experiences and contrary experience.
The real contrary event remains in the final model context and qualified answer. It is not erased or subordinated to an asserted fixed trait.

HUE2.1.scope: Original doneWhen covered in this one controlled private synthetic-person case. No requirement for a particular typed pattern record or exact answer wording was introduced.

HUE4.1.originalDoneWhen: Feedback over communicatie of gewenste hulp beïnvloedt een later gesprek over een ander onderwerp. Vermoedens over behoeften blijven toetsbare vragen; andere personen ontvangen geen privécontext.

conditions.evidence: The fourth committed reply on a different topic follows the earlier communication/help feedback by first asking which kind of help is wanted. It does not merely reproduce a formatting preference.
The response asks whether the person wants to brainstorm or take a concrete first step, without declaring feelings or needs as facts or imposing an unsolicited full plan.

Every current memory source and record is bound to the same verified private person and project. No foreign-person private source occurs in the observed contexts. Existing independently reviewed two-person CM05 isolation evidence and the already-reviewed fresh scope tests remain applicable; no second-person native case was added.

HUE4.1.scope: Original doneWhen covered by actual later behavior plus retained bounded isolation evidence. This does not establish a universal privacy guarantee or household acceptance.
